newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - M. Stanley leaps, Cisco off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - M. Stanley leaps, Cisco off.

text.p: Shares in Morgan Stanley Group Inc soared five points to 62-3/8 preceding Wednesday's market open on buying sparked by the firm's announcement that it intends to merge with Dean Witter Discover & Co.
Dean Witter shares also gained, adding 3/8 to 39 before the market open, traders said.
The two Wall Street houses unveiled early this morning a stock-swap merger, which they said will create a financial-management giant with a market capitalization of $21 billion.
Under terms of the definitve agreement approved by the boards of both companies, Dean Witter will exchange 1.85 shares for each Morgan Stanley share.
Elsewhere, Cisco Systems Inc shares faltered before the open, slipping 2-3/8 to 64-3/4 from the last regular-session Nasdaq trade Tuesday.
The company reported fiscal second quarter earnings yesterday of $0.49, $0.01 under the First Call consensus estimate.
Intel shares suffered after Prudential Securities downgraded the stock to hold from buy on valuation, traders said.
Intel traded 1-3/4 down to 163 before the market open.
Among other stocks active before the market open, 3Com Corp shed 3/4 to 58, Sun Microsystems Inc and climbed to 33-3/8 from 32-1/2 after Bear Stearns raised the stock to buy from attractive.
